VERIFIED COMPLETE — Option A (persist windows) implemented in committed code; no new code needed; full test evidence below.

OPTION CHOSEN: A (persist + rollback-protect recipient high-water/window). B (rotate keying material per restart) rejected: closed-federation peers derive contexts from static PSK/salt/IIDs (PskFederation::derive_context), so rotation would require a coordinated re-enrollment protocol change — out of scope and unnecessary.

IMPLEMENTATION (already committed on main; verified this session):
- GatewayOscoreRecipientStore (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:253-512): per-context sealed replay state {highest u64, window u32, initialized} signed with Schnorr48 over domain-separated transcript using the gateway sealing seed.
- Dual-record rollback protection: state record (gcp-oscore-recipient/) + floor record in an independent floor root; Gateway::new_persistent rejects floor roots nested inside state root (InvalidFloorAuthority, gateway.rs:849-862). Load-time recovery: state!=floor -> re-floor from state; state below floor or floor-without-state -> Corrupt (fail closed) (gateway.rs:412-447).
- Atomic-with-unprotect update: dispatch_runtime_gcp checks is_replay -> decrypt_request (successful unprotect) -> accept() persists sealed state+floor before returning (gateway.rs:1284-1304). FileStorage writes are tmp+rename atomic (lichen-hal/src/storage.rs:501-511); torn state/floor pairs self-heal on next load.
- POST /handoff flows through the same gate: /handoff staging at gateway.rs:1335 is downstream of the replay accept, so its unchecked timestamp is protected by the persisted window.

CAPTURE/REBOOT/REPLAY INTEGRATION TEST (bead's prescribed test, committed): end_to_end::runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim (rust/lichen-gateway/tests/end_to_end.rs:687-882). Real PSK federation, real client OSCORE protect, wire bytes captured; gateway dropped and reopened via Gateway::new_persistent(provision=false) with same roots+sealing seed; identical frame replayed. NON-VACUITY PROVEN: link ReplayProtector is in-memory only (lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs:524,553), so the captured frame passes link replay after restart; provision_closed_federation re-pins trust persistently and re-installs the link peer (gateway.rs:1074-1096), so only the persisted OSCORE window can reject. Replay is consumed with no second response, not forwarded upstream.

TEST EVIDENCE (cargo test -p lichen-gateway, tree as of this session): lib 203 passed/1 failed (failure = tunnel_auth revocation-vs-replay precedence, PRE-EXISTING and already tracked by beads project-LICHEN-worker6-hgq6/-t6sj/-wx3f; unrelated subsystem); end_to_end 17/17 ok; gcp_psk_oscore_vectors 11/11 ok; handoff_vectors 17/17 ok. Passing store tests: oscore_recipient_replay_store_survives_restart, oscore_sender_sequence_store_survives_restart, oscore_sender_sequence_store_rejects_tamper_and_rollback, persistent_gateway_reopens_existing_rpl_root_state.

NOTE: Python gateway already persists recipient replay ledgers (sqlite_store.py oscore_replay_ledgers + restore_replay_window); Rust was the gap and is covered. cargo fmt/clippy at close time blocked by OTHER workers' in-flight edits (lichen-hal storage.rs permissions hardening mid-save, lichend.rs/config.rs fmt drift); last clean compile of this crate passed all suites above. No files modified by this close; work was verified, not rewritten.
